scope: Availability, PIT semantics, cost, historical reach and audit admissibility of contextual data only. No feature construction, outcome inspection, model fitting or predictive testing.
audit_rules: RETRIEVABLE does not mean materialized or feature-ready.
Current snapshots may not be substituted for historical PIT state.
No paid, account-gated or unreproducible source may become a required dependency of the frozen thesis.
Data unavailable for a technique becomes an explicit NO_GO/DEFER disposition rather than a proxy fabricated from another field.
Context features that are only relevant to H3/H4/H5 remain blocked by the thesis dependency gates even when their data is retrievable.
The 66-event independent official EPS reconstruction gap remains separate from IC-07 because realized EPS is an outcome audit, not a pre-event contextual signal input.
information_completeness_implication: IC-07 removes CONTEXTUAL_DATA_AVAILABILITY_NOT_CLOSED. The project may proceed to the INFORMATION_COMPLETENESS_GATE, which must verify IC-02 through IC-07 jointly before the implementation audit is unpaused.
boundary: This PASS classifies data availability. It does not approve any candidate technique, feature, model, H2 result, H3 interaction, H4 transmission test or H5 trading rule.
